name: Printing Sequence of Numbers with a Gap Between Adjacent Values (Case 1)
description: Construct a program that prints a sequence of numbers from 1 (inclusive) to 16 (exclusive) in increments of 4.
code:
#Step 1: Iterate through the numbers in the sequence
for num in range(1, 15, 4): 
    #Step 1.1: Print each number in the sequence
    print(num)

1.content: #Step 1: Iterate through the numbers in the sequence

commentList:
We need to repeat printing the numbers that are in a sequence from 1 (inclusive) to 16 (exclusive). To do this, we need to use a loop structure. We use for loops instead of a while loop because we need to repeat the loop a certain number of times, and for loops are best-suited in cases like this when we know ahead of time the number of times that we need to repeat the loop.

We use the range function because it generates a sequence of numbers for the for loop. Here, we want a sequence of every fourth number beginning with 1 and continuing up to but not including 15. We get this sequence by calling the function range(1,15,4).

The last number in the range function specifies how much to increase each successive integer in the sequence, if this is omitted then step defaults to 1. Since we want to print only every fourth number, we set the step to 4.

Note that all statements inside the loop need to be indented with respect to the loop header.

3.content: #Step 1.1: Print each number in the sequence

commentList: This statement prints each number in the sequence to the default standard output stream. The printed text is followed by the end-of-line character at the end.
